name: Qualification of 50 kA binary LN2-cooled REBCO current leads (Ic(77 K, self-field) 58.4 kA) with LN2 subcooled to 65 K in a vacuum cryostat
plain_name: Push 50,000 amps through liquid-nitrogen-cooled superconducting power leads that feed a fusion magnet
description: Commissioning (41 kA) and post-test qualification (stable at 50 kA) of the ~3 m tall binary current leads of the MIT TFMC facility: copper heat-exchanger section cooled by boil-off N2, LN2 boiling chamber pumpable to 65 K, and six-petal REBCO section (Ic 58.4 kA at 77 K self-field).
keywords: Push 50,000 amps through liquid-nitrogen-cooled superconducting power leads that feed a fusion magnet

sources.citation: Hartwig et al., The SPARC Toroidal Field Model Coil Program, arXiv:2308.12301 (2023)

reported_equipment: 50 kA binary LN2-cooled REBCO current leads (MIT PSFC)
Alpha Scientific Electronics 50 kA power supply

requirements.rationale: Qualification demonstrated stable operation at 50 kA.
Leads housed in an evacuated current-lead cryostat.
Optional subcooling of LN2 to 65 K.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
